data.signal: Storytelling is the core differentiator for creators now. The best performers deliver with their whole body — movement, gesture, presence — not just words into a static mic. LATENT INTERPRETATION: the tension is between expressive physical performance and the capture apparatus. Creators aspire to embodied delivery (stage presence norms migrating to short-form video), but recording tools were designed for stationary use. The friction is lived wherever performance meets equipment: talking-head creators, walk-and-talk vloggers, fitness/dance instructors, workshop presenters. Communities where this is discussed: r/NewTubers, r/VideoEditing, r/podcasting, creator YouTube comment sections, TikTok creator forums.

polymath_evidence.summary: Expressive storytelling benefits from embodied delivery: gesture and movement increase audience retention and perceived authenticity
Creator differentiation increasingly rests on physical delivery quality rather than information content alone
Performance traditions (stage, oratory) treat hands and torso as primary expressive instruments; tools that occupy hands reduce expressive range

behaviors: performing with whole-body gesture while speaking to camera
adaptations: staying seated to keep mic quality
constraints: capture system must preserve movement and gesture
audio quality cannot be sacrificed for mobility

challenges.argument: Wearable wireless is a crowded category (DJI/Rode dominate) — the bridge may be valid but the commercial delta unclear; keep, demand product-delta evidence later
Magnets near electronics and thin fabrics raise practical concerns; but workaround evidence would directly support; strongest falsifiability
Garment integration fights sizing/washing/style variety — high alternative-explanation pressure from cheaper external mounts
Repositioning frequency is the crux; if low, dock carrier is a solution seeking a problem

Round-1 field evidence: 4 independent DIY magnetic mounts (community-authored), purchase-intent across 3 sources, product complaints about clip attachment. First-person community friction quotes still missing (gap open). Bridge holding strongly.
No admissible community behavior evidence surfaced this round; category crowded (DJI/Rode/Shure). Holding — magnet path carries the same invariant with better delta.
No cross-industry pattern penetration found in creator discussions round-1. Unproven, not disproven — holding.
